notes.title: Sleep keeps some of the day
notes.science: During sleep, the brain keeps some of the day's memories and lets others go.
notes.limits: The bubbles are a picture, not a model of dreams.
notes.counter: How much dreams matter for memory is still argued.
notes.question: What would a creature here dream about?

notes.title: A night between
notes.science: Sleep changes how we feel about the day. People who miss sleep react more strongly to bad news the next morning.
notes.limits: Nothing in the sim changes while the creatures sleep here.
notes.counter: Some say a night only hides a grudge for a while.
notes.question: Does a night make a quarrel smaller?

sources.label: Overnight Therapy? The Role of Sleep in Emotional Brain Processing, Walker and van der Helm, 2009
